name: Ford Ranger pickup (unarmed)
origin: United States (T6 generation engineered by Ford Australia)
armament: None fitted; police and Taliban crews fire from the cab and bed (pintle MG mounts are improvised)
protection: Unarmoured. Under the game rule the body is immune to small-calibre fire, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire.
visual_notes: Double-cab 4x4 pickup, T6 (2011-2022) styling: large trapezoid grille, swept headlamps, squared wheel arches
Afghan police fleet: dark green paint, white 'Police' lettering or Taliban white-flag decals, roll bar and roof light bar, bench seats in the bed
Taliban use often adds a white Islamic Emirate flag on a whip antenna, fighters sitting on the bed rails
Mexican patrol versions (game stand-in for Ford Lobo / Ram): grey or green paint, roll-bar MG mount, troops on bench seats facing out
Shares proportions with the Hilux/technical voxel chassis: can be modelled as a reskin with a new nose
variants: ex-Afghan National Police green patrol pickup (afg_taliban signature)
Ford Lobo / F-series and Ram patrol pickups (mex; game stand-in, moved from toyota_hilux)
